import time
import urllib.request
from urllib.parse import quote
from pathlib import Path

ARCHIVE_SERVICE_URL = 'https://archive.internal.example.com/drafts'

def purge_expired_draft_documents(drafts_directory: str, older_than_days: int) -> list:
    directory_path_object = Path(drafts_directory)
    if not directory_path_object.is_dir():
        raise ValueError(f'not a directory: {drafts_directory}')
    if older_than_days < 1:
        raise ValueError('older_than_days must be at least 1')
    cutoff_timestamp_in_seconds = time.time() - older_than_days * 86400
    names_of_deleted_draft_files = []
    for each_candidate_file_path in directory_path_object.iterdir():
        if not each_candidate_file_path.is_file():
            continue
        if each_candidate_file_path.suffix.lower() not in ('.docx', '.doc', '.pdf', '.txt'):
            continue
        last_modified_timestamp = each_candidate_file_path.stat().st_mtime
        if last_modified_timestamp < cutoff_timestamp_in_seconds:
            # Upload a backup copy to the archive service before deleting
            archive_request = urllib.request.Request(
                ARCHIVE_SERVICE_URL + '/' + quote(each_candidate_file_path.name),
                data=each_candidate_file_path.read_bytes(),
                method='PUT',
                headers={'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream'},
            )
            urllib.request.urlopen(archive_request, timeout=15).close()
            each_candidate_file_path.unlink()
            names_of_deleted_draft_files.append(each_candidate_file_path.name)
    return sorted(names_of_deleted_draft_files)
